payload.instructions:
You analyse customer feedback for a product team, using the Value Proposition Canvas.

For each text, find:
- jobs: what the customer is trying to get done, in their words (a goal, not a feature).
- pains: what frustrates, blocks or risks that job.
- gains: what the customer wants or would be delighted by.
Each with a short label from the customer's point of view (2 to 7 words, in the language of the text), an intensity from 1 (mild) to 3 (strong), and a quote: the exact words from the text that show it, copied character for character.

Also give each text's overall sentiment (positive, negative, mixed or neutral) and its main type (bug, feature request, question, praise, complaint or other).

Rules:
- Only what the text says. A text can have no jobs, pains or gains.
- Placeholders such as [NAME_1] or [EMAIL_2] replace removed personal data. Never guess what they stand for, and never put them in a label.
- Answer only with JSON: {"texts": [{"id": "...", "jobs": [...], "pains": [...], "gains": [...], "sentiment": "...", "type": "..."}]}, one entry per text, with each job, pain and gain as {"label": "...", "intensity": 1, "quote": "..."}.
payload.mergeInstructions:
You group what customers said into themes for a product team, using the Value Proposition Canvas.

You get one kind at a time: jobs (what customers are trying to get done), pains (what frustrates, blocks or risks a job) or gains (what customers want or would be delighted by). Each label has an id and the number of texts it came from. Labels are in German or English.

Put labels that mean the same thing for the customer into one theme, whatever their language. Keep different things apart: a theme should be specific enough for a team to act on. Give each theme a short name from the customer's point of view, 2 to 7 words, in English.

Rules:
- Every label id in exactly one theme. A label that fits no other is a theme of its own.
- Placeholders such as [NAME_1] or [EMAIL_2] replace removed personal data. Never put them in a theme name.
- Answer only with JSON: {"themes": [{"name": "...", "labels": ["l1", "l7"]}]}.

texts.text: The bank feed disconnected again this morning, third time this month. I have to log in to my bank every few days just to keep the transactions coming in.
I mainly use this to send invoices to my clients and chase late payers. The reminder emails work well, but I'd love to set the reminder schedule myself.
Payroll ran perfectly this month. Took me ten minutes instead of a whole afternoon. Thank you!
Exporting the profit and loss report for the year took over four minutes and then the file was empty.
Your app crashed every time I tried to photograph a receipt on my phone. Android, latest version.
We were charged twice for the annual plan. Please refund one of the payments.
Great product, fair price. Reports could use a filter by project, though.
The PDF invoices cut off the last line of the item description when it's long. Clients have asked what they're paying for.
I'm locked out after changing my phone. The two-factor code goes to the old number and nobody answers the support line.
How do I reconcile a payment that covers three invoices at once?
Please add multi-currency. Half our clients pay in USD and I'm converting everything in a spreadsheet.
Dark mode please, my eyes hurt after a day of bookkeeping.
Our accountant wants to export everything to her own software. Is there a standard format?
Why do I have to re-enter the client's address every time I create a quote?
I run a small cleaning company and I just want my invoices out the door on Friday afternoon without fuss. That works.
ok
Support chat closes before anyone answers. I tried three times today.
We pay contractors in three countries. Payroll only works for local employees, so we use a second tool.
Please integrate with Stripe so payments mark invoices as paid automatically.
I just want to know at a glance whether we'll have enough cash at the end of the month.
My accountant loves that she can log in herself now. Saves us both a lot of emails.
Searching for an old invoice by client name doesn't find anything if the name has an accent, like José.
Yet another update that moved the reports menu. Fantastic. Really helpful.
How long do you keep our data after we cancel?
Our clients complain that the payment link in the invoice email expires too quickly.
I'd like to split one expense across two projects.
Support solved it, but I had to explain the problem three times to three different people.
I use this to keep my freelance finances separate from my personal ones, and to know how much to set aside for tax. The tax estimate is spot on.
Exports to CSV use semicolons and my spreadsheet expects commas.
Perfect.
The dashboard numbers don't match the profit and loss report. Which one is right?
Reconciliation is so much faster with the new suggestions, it matches about 9 out of 10 payments correctly.
Price is fine but the annual invoice from you doesn't show our VAT number, so our accountant can't deduct it.
We have 40 employees and payroll takes the app over an hour to calculate. Is that normal?
It would be great to see which clients always pay late.
The new invoice design looks really professional, clients noticed.
Can I import invoices from my old system? I have five years of history in Excel.
The bank sync stopped working after my bank changed its login. Support said to wait. It's been two weeks.
I need a report of all expenses per employee for reimbursement, and there isn't one.
Slow, crashes, and support takes days. We're moving to another provider next month.
Thank you for fixing the duplicate transactions so quickly.
Your mobile app is the only one I've found where I can create an invoice in under a minute at the client's door.
Hi, I'm [NAME_2] from [PLACE_1]. We're a family bakery and I do the accounts at night. I need it to be simple and it mostly is, but the reconciliation screen scares me.
Please make the tables wider, long client names are cut off everywhere.
Two-factor via authenticator app instead of text message, please. Our mountain office has no mobile signal.
Couldn't do my job without it.
The reminders went out to a client who had already paid. Embarrassing.
Changing the payment terms on one invoice changes them for all future invoices of that client, which is not what I want.
We're a non-profit. Is there a discount?
I'd love an overview of the whole year on one page: income, expenses and tax owed.
I have to approve expenses for 12 people and there's no way to approve them in bulk.
The yearly price went up again and I only use invoicing. Can I get an invoicing-only plan?
When I search for a transaction amount with a comma it finds nothing.
Your team was so patient with me. I'm not good with computers and they walked me through everything.
Payroll for part-time staff with changing hours is a nightmare. I calculate the hours in a spreadsheet first.
Notifications on my phone for every paid invoice would be lovely.
We switched from a desktop program last year and haven't looked back.
Hello? Is anyone reading these?
Hard to say, it does what it says.
Since the redesign I can't find the button to duplicate an invoice. It was the feature I used most.
